name: token-lens
description: Read-only token lens: where tokens go, wasteful patterns, and tips, with an original pixel mascot. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane, band and toasts (en or az). /tokens lang overrides it.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show one line above the prompt: mascot face, context %, last warning.

animation.title: Animate the mascot
animation.description: Off shows one still frame (reduced motion).

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Show a toast for warnings (never for info).

max_toasts.title: Max toasts per session
max_toasts.description: At most this many toasts per session (0 to 50).

cooldown_minutes.title: Toast cooldown (minutes)
cooldown_minutes.description: Minutes before the same rule may toast again.

repeat_read_threshold.title: R1: repeat reads
repeat_read_threshold.description: Reads of one file, with no edit in between, before R1 fires.

huge_output_tokens.title: R2: huge output (tokens)
huge_output_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of one tool result before R2 fires.

full_file_read_tokens.title: R3: full-file read (tokens)
full_file_read_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of a Read with no offset/limit before R3 fires.

error_loop_threshold.title: R4: errors in a row
error_loop_threshold.description: Consecutive tool errors before R4 fires.

context_warn_percent.title: R7: context warning (%)
context_warn_percent.description: Context fill that raises a warning.

context_strong_percent.title: R7: strong context warning (%)
context_strong_percent.description: Context fill that raises a strong warning.

subagent_share_percent.title: R8: subagent share (%)
subagent_share_percent.description: Share of a turn's tokens used by subagents before R8 notes it.

ring_size.title: Ledger size
ring_size.description: Tool calls kept in memory for the Tools tab (50 to 5000).

lru_size.title: Repeat-read memory
lru_size.description: Files remembered for repeat-read detection (20 to 2000).
